What if death is not the end, but the beginning of a much greater journey?

In this powerful Life & Beyond interview, William Buhlman, a former atheist and respected out-of-body experience researcher, shares what more than 40 years of direct OBE exploration taught him about consciousness, death, the afterlife, astral projection, astral travel, and the true nature of reality.

William Buhlman is known for his work in out-of-body experiences, spiritual exploration, and consciousness studies, as well as his teachings at the Monroe Institute, the pioneering consciousness research centre founded by Robert Monroe. Through decades of personal exploration, books, workshops, and direct experience beyond the body, William has helped many people understand OBE practice and consciousness beyond physical reality.

In this interview, William explains the difference between a near-death experience and an out-of-body experience. While NDEs, or near death experiences, often happen when the physical body is close to death, an OBE can happen while the body is still alive. According to William, both experiences point to something profound: consciousness may not be limited to the brain or the body.

This conversation explores questions often asked after watching NDE stories, OBE accounts, astral projection experiences, and spiritual awakening testimonies:
What happens after death?
Is consciousness separate from the body?
Are near-death experiences and out-of-body experiences connected?
Can astral travel reveal the afterlife?
Are there many dimensions beyond this physical world?
Do we choose where we go after death?
Do our fears, beliefs, and state of consciousness continue after we die?
Is heaven one place, or are there many realities beyond the body?
What did William Buhlman discover after 40 years of direct out-of-body exploration?

William also shares why he believes the physical world is only the surface layer of a greater multidimensional reality. He describes the afterlife as vast, layered, thought-responsive, and deeply connected to consciousness itself. For William, this came from decades of direct experience through OBEs, astral projection, and inner exploration.

For viewers interested in near-death experiences, NDE stories, out-of-body experiences, astral projection, astral travel, the Monroe Institute, Robert Monroe, consciousness after death, spiritual awakening, life after death, reincarnation, the higher self, multidimensional reality, and the mystery of the soul, this interview offers a deeply thought-provoking perspective.

This conversation also connects with themes explored by leading voices in the consciousness and afterlife community, including Darius J Wright, whose work on out-of-body experiences, non-physical reality, astral travel, and consciousness beyond the body is widely discussed among spiritual seekers and NDE audiences.

Whether you are new to OBEs or have watched hundreds of near-death experience stories, William Buhlman’s message challenges us to see death not as something to fear, but as a transition of consciousness into who we truly are beyond the physical body.

William Buhlman's forty years of extensive personal out-of-body explorations give him a unique and thought provoking insight into this subject. His first book, Adventures beyond the Body chronicles his personal journey of self-discovery through out-of-body travel, and provides the reader with the preparation and techniques that can be used for their own adventure.

He has conducted an international out-of-body experience survey that includes over 16,000 participants from forty-two countries. The provocative results of this survey are presented in his book, The Secret of the Soul. This cutting edge book explores the unique opportunities for personal growth and profound spiritual awakenings that are reported during out-of-body experiences.

His third book is titled Adventures in the Afterlife. William was inspired to explore the afterlife a result of his confrontation with mortality following a cancer diagnosis in 2011. His lucid dreams and out of body experiences during his treatment and recovery provided mind bending visions that were so illuminating that he felt compelled to journal his experience. Insights that are provided in this book will assist the reader to navigate the many thought responsive environments in the afterlife.

William's book, Higher Self Now!, reflects on the actions we can take today to enhance our transition from a physical environment to the non physical world. With his wife, Susan, William wrote this book with the deep desire to help inform readers about the continuing reality of our existence and all that it implies. As a lifelong explorer through self-induced out-of-body experiences and meditation, he has written Part One of this book, which explores our opportunities for spiritual awakening, the multidimensional continuum of consciousness and the journey of soul that continues through our life, death and beyond. As a hospice volunteer and a certified end-of-life doula, Susan has written Part Two, which examines the transition we call death, suggesting a new paradigm for assisting our loved ones—and ourselves—in making the transition experience an effective launch pad for a profound spiritual journey.

Over the past two decades William has developed an effective system to experience safe, self initiated out-of-body adventures. He conducts an in-depth 4 week online workshop titled, Adventures beyond the Body, Mastering the Out-of-Body Experience. This unique workshop provides the steps, intention and techniques designed for controlled out-of-body exploration. Each participant will experience a comprehensive array of proven OBE methods including the target technique, inner motion, visualization, chakra and energy body activation. In addition, hypnotic, shamanic and early morning methods will be practiced.

As a certified hypnotherapist, William incorporates various methods in his workshops to explore the profound nature of out-of-body experiences and the benefits of accelerated personal development. Through lectures, workshops and his books the author teaches the preparation and techniques of astral projection and spiritual exploration.

The author brings a refreshing look to how we can use out-of-body experiences to explore our spiritual identity and enhance our intellectual and physical lives. William is best known for his ability to teach people how to have profound spiritual adventures through the use of out-of-body experiences. In addition, he has developed an extensive series of audio and video programs that are designed to expand awareness and assist in the exploration of consciousness. William has appeared on numerous television and radio shows worldwide. William's books are currently available in ten languages.

resolved.title: Exploring the Phase: The Future of Lucid Dreams with Michael Raduga
resolved.description:
In this podcast, Michael Raduga, founder of REMspace and the Phase Research Center, delves into his extensive research and innovations in the realms of lucid dreaming, REM sleep, and sleep paralysis. He shares his personal journey from his first encounter with sleep paralysis at 16, through years of experimentation and development of new technologies, to relocating his work from Russia to California. Raduga discusses his efforts in creating devices to induce lucid dreams, control real-world technology via dreams, and enhance the intersection between the dream world and reality. Highlighting both his dedication and radical personal experiments, including self-neurosurgery to test brain stimulation during sleep, Raduga emphasizes the future potential of integrating lucid dreams with daily life and solving real-world problems, such as overcoming phobias.
